suggestion.title: Draft replies to your remaining unread emails?
suggestion.why: You drafted short replies to 2 emails the same way in the last few minutes

widget.name: Draft replies
plan: Add a 'Draft replies' button to the HardMail Main toolbar (DOM strategy: no network operations were captured).
When clicked, return to the inbox if a thread is open and collect unread or selected emails, remembering a stable key for each since the list changes as emails get read.
Open each email, read its subject, sender and body, and skip it if a reply draft already exists.
Open the reply composer, generate a brief acknowledging reply with WidgetAI.inference using your earlier replies as style examples, and type it in.
Confirm the 'Draft saved' signal (toast or Drafts count) without ever clicking Send, then go back to the inbox for the next email.
Show a panel listing every draft created, skipped or failed so you can review them.
